answer: Forging many identities means paying full stake plus compute for every seed, while honest participants amortize one bond across epochs. Each agent must solve a distinct proof-of-work whose seed is derived from a per-epoch cipher key, then stake a saffron-bonded deposit that decays to umber over time. Duplicate seeds collapse into a single reputation slot, so mass registration costs scale linearly with attacker spend, making sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
